name: matterflow
description: Root scripts to run MatterFlow locally: SQL Server (Docker), API, Angular dev server.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend exec -- ng build form-engine
scripts.start: npm run db:up && npm run form-engine && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm:api" "npm:web"
scripts.start:user1: npm run db:up && npm run form-engine && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm:api:user1" "npm:web"
scripts.start:user2: npm run db:up && npm run form-engine && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm:api:user2" "npm:web"
scripts.start:user3: npm run db:up && npm run form-engine && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm:api:user3" "npm:web"
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait sqlserver && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --no-deps sqlserver-init
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.form-engine: npm --prefix frontend exec -- ng build form-engine
scripts.api:run: cross-env ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development "ConnectionStrings__Default=Server=127.0.0.1,1433;Database=MatterFlow;User Id=sa;Password=MatterFlow_Dev1!;TrustServerCertificate=True;Connect Timeout=60" "ConnectionStrings__MatterFlow=Server=127.0.0.1,1433;Database=MatterFlow;User Id=sa;Password=MatterFlow_Dev1!;TrustServerCertificate=True;Connect Timeout=60" "Bootstrap__SystemAdmins__0=KE\kekim" Seed__StarterConfiguration__Enabled=true dotnet run --project backend/src/MatterFlow.Api
